# Set-Up

## Libraries

```{r}
library(sf)
library(spatstat)
library(spopt)
# library(smoothr)
library(rmapshaper)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
```

## Project Specific Functions

```{r}
source("03_scripts/01_functions.R")
```

## Plotting Defaults

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```


# Import Data

## RTS

```{r}
high_prob_rts_pt <- st_read("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson")
rts_pt <- st_read("./01_processed_data/verified_rts_pt.geojson")
```

## Domain

```{r}
domain <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_south_clean.geojson")
domain_grid <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_grid_50km.geojson")
```

## Environmental Predictors

```{r}
env_pred <- rast(
  "./01_processed_data/env_pred_rescale_6931.tif"
)

env_pred <- env_pred |>
  select(-names(env_pred)[which(str_detect(names(env_pred), "b1"))]) |>
  select(-names(env_pred)[which(str_detect(names(env_pred), "suitable"))]) |>
  select(-"hillslope_thermokarst")
```

## NaturalEarth

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  select(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
```

```{r}
crop_poly <- tibble(
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 90)), crs = 'EPSG:4326')
) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt)) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 5250000) %>%
  smoothr::densify(n = 3) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:4326')

crop_bbox <- crop_poly |>
  st_transform(6931) |>
  st_bbox()

long_lines <- seq(-180, 180, by = 60) %>%
  map(
    ~ long_lines_from_coords(.x, lat_min = st_bbox(crop_poly)[2], lat_max = 90)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

lat_lines <- seq(50, 90, by = 10) %>%
  map(~ lat_lines_from_coords(.x, lon_min = -180, lon_max = 180)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
russia <- world |>
  filter(name == "Russia") |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(id = 1:n())

# West Wrangell Island is 29, East Wrangell Island is 31
russia$geometry[29] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[29], dist = 0.11)
russia$geometry[31] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[31], dist = 0.11)

russia <- russia |>
  select(-id)

russia <- russia |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(russia),
    .by = c(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
  )

world <- world |>
  filter(name != "Russia") |>
  rbind(russia)


world_north <- world %>%
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(crop_poly) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt))

rm(russia)
```

# RTS Regions
This section creates RTS regions (spatially contiguous hotspot and coldspot regions) using the SKATER (Spatial 'K'luster Analysis by Tree Edge Removal) algorithm. Since RTS count is the attribute of interest for this clustering, I have first gridded the entire region and extracted RTS counts. 

## Gridded Variables

### RTS Counts

```{r}
domain_grid <- domain_grid |>
  st_join(rts_pt) |>
  summarise(
    rts_count = sum(!is.na(rts_id)),
    .by = geometry
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rts_count_log10 = case_when(
      rts_count > 0 ~ log10(rts_count),
      TRUE ~ -2
    ),
    .after = rts_count
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  domain_grid,
  aes(x = rts_count)
) +
  geom_histogram()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  geom_sf(
    data = domain_grid,
    aes(color = rts_count, fill = rts_count)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  geom_sf(
    data = domain_grid,
    aes(color = rts_count_log10, fill = rts_count_log10)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count\n(modified log10)",
    # trans = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count\n(modified log10)",
    # trans = "log10"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```

## SKATER
The floor based on cell area (used to enforce a minimum region size) is not working. The algorithm is returning more regions than requested, except when it thinks the floor is too big and it reduces the number of regions to 1. I am unable to get it to work with a reasonable floor size; it tells me the floor is too big before it reaches a size that would actually get rid of small regions.

Could also try with queen adjacency again.

```{r}
rts_regions <- skater(
  domain_grid,
  attrs = c("rts_count_log10", "glacial_extent_lgm", "ecoregions"),
  weights = "rook",
  n_regions = 16,
  bridge_islands = TRUE,
  # floor = "grid_area",
  # floor_value = 20000,
  seed = 42
) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .by = .region) %>%
  mutate(centroid = st_centroid(geometry)) %>%
  bind_cols(
    .$centroid %>%
      st_transform(4326) %>%
      st_coordinates
  ) |>
  arrange(X)
```

## Clean-Up
Smooth and clip to land area:

```{r}
rts_regions_smooth <- rts_regions |>
  smooth_shared(
    window = 4,
    dens = 5e4, # 50 km
    iter = 1,
    smooth_outer = TRUE,
  )

diag <- smooth_diagnostics(
  rts_regions,
  rts_regions_smooth,
  id = ".region",
  buffer = 1e5,
  area_tol = 100
)
```


Name regions:

```{r}
rts_regions_smooth <- rts_regions_smooth %>%
  arrange(X) %>%
  mutate(
    # name = seq(1, n())
    name = c(
      seq(1, 7),
      seq(7, 11),
      11,
      seq(11, 15),
      rep(15, 2)
    ) # This clean up is manual and will not be necessary if I can get the floor argument to work in SKATER
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(geometry),
    .by = c(name)
  ) %>%
  st_intersection(domain) %>%
  mutate(
    centroid = st_centroid(geometry),
    .before = geometry
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(
    .$centroid %>%
      st_transform(4326) %>%
      st_coordinates
  ) |>
  arrange(X)
```

# Regional Characteristics

## Size and Shape by Region
Options for measuring shape:
Polsby-Popper (area compared to circle with same perimeter; just need area and perimeter)
Reock (area compared to smallest square containing the shape; need full geometry)
Convex Hull (area compared to area of convex hull of shape; need full geometry)
CIRCLE (area compared to area of smallest circumscribing circle; need full geometry)

I will start with Polsby-Popper as I have used previously due to it's simplicity.
```{r}
rts_pt <- rts_pt |>
  st_join(rts_regions_smooth |> select(name, region_lon = X, region_lat = Y)) |>
  mutate(
    pp = (4 * pi * area_m2) / perimeter_m^2
  )

high_prob_rts_pt <- high_prob_rts_pt |>
  st_join(rts_regions_smooth |> select(name, region_lon = X, region_lat = Y)) |>
  mutate(
    pp = (4 * pi * area_m2) / perimeter_m^2
  )

rts_regions_smooth <- rts_regions_smooth |>
  full_join(
    rts_pt |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      summarise(
        mean_pp = mean(pp),
        mean_area_m2 = mean(area_m2),
        .by = name
      ),
    by = "name"
  ) |>
  full_join(
    high_prob_rts_pt |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      summarise(
        mean_pp_high_prob = mean(pp),
        mean_area_m2_high_prob = mean(area_m2),
        .by = name
      ),
    by = "name"
  )
```
